stage_policy: Every stage requires its own frozen preregistration and independent audit before execution. A passed parent gate does not authorize cache creation or training.
user_intent: After the numerical parent gate passes, continue toward long training, but only through the immutable audited DAG.

history.K4: K4 is separate train-only correction research and is not this parent gate.
history.R54: R54 is historical neural training evidence and is not imported into this numerical gate.
history.old_v1_smoke: Historical only; never a prerequisite or selection source.

parent_gate_claim: Diagnostic-only exposed-train comparison of numerical arms A and B; no validation/test_id, cache, neural training, or promotion claim.
